schema_repairs.yuki_write: Create a file in Yuki's own internal managed file store, or replace that file's entire contents. Use when the requested content should overwrite or start fresh. Do not use when existing contents must be preserved.
schema_repairs.yuki_append: Preserve an existing file's contents in Yuki's own internal managed file store and add the supplied content after them. Use only for append/add/extend/continue intent. Do not use to create fresh contents or replace a file.
